title: Local Equivalence Classes of Distance-Hereditary Graphs using Split Decompositions
summary: Local complement is a graph operation formalized by Bouchet which replaces the neighborhood of a chosen vertex with its edge-complement. This operation induces an equivalence relation on graphs; determining the size of the resulting equivalence classes is a challenging problem in general. Bouchet obtained formulas only for paths and cycles, and brute-force methods are limited to very small graphs.
